row: Jenn Chew | Vancouver Physiotherapist for Runners

Hi, I'm Jennifer Chew, a Registered Physiotherapist and co-owner of Form Physiotherapy in Vancouver, BC.

I specialize in helping runners, athletes, lifters, and active individuals recover from injuries, improve performance, and move stronger.

On this channel, you'll find evidence-based physiotherapy advice on:
• Running injuries & rehabilitation
• Achilles tendinopathy, plantar fasciitis & knee pain
• Running biomechanics & gait analysis
• Strength training & injury prevention

With years of experience treating recreational runners to competitive marathoners, my goal is to simplify movement science and help you train smarter.

I practice at Form Physiotherapy in Vancouver, providing evidence-based care for runners and active individuals.
